name: miningdata
description: Mining Data API: drill results, financings, financial statements, projects, technical reports and spin-outs extracted from public filings. Read-only, OAuth sign-in, requires an active Mining Data API subscription.

interface.longDescription:
Ask for the strongest recent drill intercepts, a briefing on a ticker, every placement above a price, or project economics such as NPV and IRR. Mining Data API answers from structured facts extracted from public filings of listed mining companies: drill results, financings, financial statements, projects, technical reports and spin-outs. Every answer can cite the disclosure it came from.

All tools are read-only. You sign in with your Mining Data API account; an active paid subscription is required for data tools (usage and plan information work on every plan).
defaultPrompt: Show me the best gold drill intercepts released in the last 30 days.
Build a briefing on ABRA.V: flagship project, drilling, financings and cash runway.
Which lithium projects in Argentina have a published after-tax NPV?
